== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ローディアン</span>. Three asterisks precede the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">同じ位置カード上の自分のバウンティ・ハンターと密輸屋はそれぞれ戦闘力＋1。ただし「グリード」は逆に戦闘力－1となる。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋1。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">スークーは典型的なローディアン男性だ。チャッザ族の長、赤のナヴィックの命令でグリードを殺しに来た。ローディアンは“狩り”を好み、多くが暗殺者として雇われている。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Rodian]].

'''Lore''' — Suku is a typical male Rodian. On orders from Navik the Red, head of the Chattza tribe, he came to kill Greedo. Rodians like the hunt, and many are hired as assassins.

'''Game text''' — Your bounty hunters and smugglers at the same location card are each power +1. Greedo is instead power -1. Adds 1 to the power of any starship he pilots.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese names Suku (スークー) where English names Thuku, and Greedo as 「グリード」. Same-site bonus uses 位置カード. Three asterisks match English restricted dots.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-rodian-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Rodian]].</ref>
